reviewedRevision: 2739506 plus the rework in this commit
owner: owner-iron, then owner-iron2 after a session restart
reviewNote: Round 3 approved earlier hashes of iron-bastion.js, -data.js and the quality test. The final change only gives fields 1 and 2 a later first arrival and slower enemy reload after the browser check found an idle tank lost field 1 in 11.5 s; at the user's request to reduce reviews it was verified by one suite run and a browser check, not a fourth review round.
independentProbes: The reviewer's own reaction-limited aiming bot, reading only public state, cleared every field by keyboard and pointer at 60 and 120 Hz and won 6 of 6 full 24-field campaigns; at 30 Hz the keyboard bot missed 4 of 144 late-field runs because of coarse turret keying. Twenty blind policies (pointer sweeps, random taps, mash, idle and others) won at most 12% of any field from field 3 at 100 seeds. 29,000 construction positions trapped no tank; fuzz with hostile dt and pointer values (178,000 frames) broke no invariant; trajectories were bit-equal at 30, 60, 120 and 240 Hz.

findings.observation: Only 3 battlefields and no select or continue. There are now 24 data-driven fields (raiders, gunners, brick and steel, heavies, weaving scouts, kit drops, chasing raiders, armored heavies, mixed rosters) with accurate bilingual tips, a level select and env.progress continue; broken stores are safe.

Blind pointer play won: sweeping the spawn row won 38.5% of campaigns and random taps 65%. Rounds are now scarce per field, the cannon has a four-shell magazine, later enemies weave or carry armor, and env.random varies lanes and timing; no blind policy exceeds 12% of any field from field 3.

Added tests/iron-bastion-quality.test.js: blind and mash bounds, frame-rate trajectory equality, EN/ZH identical play, hostile dt and pointer values, broken progress stores, per-field scripted clears and unconditional terminal assertions.

Exported data is deep-frozen, dead code removed, a 6 px pointer dead zone stops the turret snapping east, the 1,143-line file is split into seven modules, late-field pressure no longer eases from field 13, cover skipped at a field change is rebuilt once the slot is clear, and the cover-layout tests were tightened to the measured margins.

Found in the browser check: an idle tank lost the tutorial field in 11.5 s, before a new player could read the tip. Fields 1 and 2 now hold the first arrival (13 s and 4 s) and slow enemy reload; an idle tank lasts about 31 s on field 1 and 25 s on field 2, and a test asserts it.

openNotes: Late fields are about as demanding as the middle, not clearly harder: pressure is flat from field 20 and the ammo budget is not monotonic (field 24 has 52 rounds).
Every full clear scores about the same, so the score does not separate skilled from average play.
The beacon-front test counts reachable cells in a box rather than checking a specific approach.
The 30 Hz keyboard bot misses about 1 in 36 late-field runs; the app always steps at 1/120 s.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, Play again, the language switch, the touch buttons and the field, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened field 1 of 24 (Courtyard); Up drove the tank and Space fired four shells (29 to 25 rounds).
English loss: armor ran out and the loss screen explained it; Space on the loss screen changed nothing, and Play again restarted field 1 with full armor and 29 rounds.

Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): the Fire touch button and a tap on the field fired (29 to 26 rounds); the seven touch buttons are 左 右 上 下 射击 刹车瞄准 维修. The Chinese loss message was shown.
After the teaching-field fix (served hashes 83778e4a and ac8b4196): an idle tank on field 1 took its first hit at 18.1 s and lost at 31.6 s, against 5.5 s and 11.5 s before.
Not covered in the browser: a field win, the level select and touch driving, which the reviewer's pointer and keyboard bots and the quality tests cover.
